item.title: Who's to Blame for This One: Assigning Blame in a Mahjong Game Log
item.description:
Origin Link to heading

After dealing into a fourth place, I wanted to curse the RNG, but honestly I wasn’t sure: was this hand simply unplayable, or did I just play it badly? The trouble with mahjong is that there’s a thick layer of variance between the outcome and the process — a single game can’t settle anything, but a person only ever gets to play one game at a time.
